name: Gillesrais
introduce:
HU-08M Gillesrais
Made by the UKB-1, this heavy ST utilizes a unique Arashium alloy smelting technique, distinct from that used by Obsidian.
This proprietary smelting method allows the Arashium to form a unique lattice structure in its inner frame and actuator, greatly enhancing durability and facilitating self-repair capabilities.

20174.name: Liquid Repair Kit
20174.SpecificEffects: When HP falls below <color=#F74848>50%</color>, there is a <color=#F74848>100%</color> chance to restore <color=#F74848>6%</color> HP after taking damage, effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

30158.name: Adaptive Mod
30158.SpecificEffects:
When HP is below <color=#F74848>50%</color>, DMG Taken <color=#F74848>-18%</color>.
When HP is above <color=#F74848>50%</color>, DMG <color=#F74848>+20%</color>.
